title: Atlantis
tagline: An un-opinionated modular DAO framework geared towards cascading sub-DAOs and cross-DAO composability.
description: Atlantis is a highly customisable DAO framework. Atlantis allows a DAO to own any asset class with no interface restrictions. With tokenised executables, Atlantis makes off-chain voting execution verifiable. A heavy focus has been placed on inter-DAO collaboration, making Atlantis highly composable, as well as enabling cascading sub-DAOs.
how_its_made: Atlantis is a DAO framework built entirely in Solidity. Atlantis is designed in a modular and composable framework, allowing for parts to be used as needed. Through its modularity users can customise each and every part of the system as needed. The composable nature also allows deployed DAOs to evolve with the communities needs.
